chalak ramro anubhav bhayeko ra jeep ko awastha ramro bhayeko chhannus. dherai manchhe ra saman ladeko jeep ma nachadhnus. barsha ma pahiro jaane thau ma rokinu parne bhaye driver ko kura sunnus. jhola halka rakhnus ra mulyawan saman sangai rakhnus.
domestic flight ma kati saman lana milchha?

airline anusar niyam farak hunchha, tyasaile ticket ki airline ko website ma hernus. dherai jaso hulak saman ra haat ko jhola ko chhuttai sima hunchha. badhi saman bhaye thap paisa tirnu parchha. lighter, dhaardar chakku jasta saman haat ko jhola ma narakhnus.
jungle ma bato haraye bhane k garne?

aatinus ra ekai thau ma rokinus, bhaagda jhan tadha haraincha. phone ma signal chha bhane 100 ma ki saathi lai phone garnus ra location pathaunus. ujyalo chhanda khola ki bato tira bistarai jaanus, raati nahidnus. sitti, torch ra thap pani sadhai jhola ma rakhnus.
nadi tarnu paryo, pul chhaina

pani ko gati ra gahirai thaha nabhai kahile pani natarnus, ghuda bhanda mathi pani le pani manchhe bagauna sakchha. sakesamma pul bhayeko arko bato khojnus. barsha ma ekai ghanta ma pani badhna sakchha, parkhanu nai surakshit ho. sthaniya manchhe sanga bato sodhnus.
india border paar gari jaane, k kagaj chahinchha?

nepali nagarik lai sadharan yatra ma dherai jaso nagarikta ki aru photo bhayeko parichaya patra chahinchha, tara niyam farak parna sakchha. jaanu agadi border ko karyalaya ki yatayat company sanga pakka bujhnus. kagaj ko photocopy ra photo sangai rakhnus. bharatiya rupiya satna aadhikarik thau matra prayog garnus.
raati khutta ko nasa tanchha, ekdam dukhchha

nasa tanda khutta sidha gari aunla aafu tira bistarai tannus ra maansapeshi lai bistarai malish garnus. din bhari pani pugne gari piunus, khas gari garmi ra kaam pachhi. sutnu agadi khutta ko halka stretching garnus. bar bar hune, sunnine ki kamjori bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
achanak mutu dhakdhak hune, saas phulne, marchhu jasto lagchha kahile kahi

yasto bela bistarai saas linus: 4 second bhitra, 4 second rokne, 6 second bahira, 5-10 palta. warpar ka 5 wata chij herera naam bhannus, dimag lai ahile ma lyauchha. tara pahilo palta yasto bhaye ki chhati dukhyo bhane mutu ko jaanch ko lagi turuntai aspatal jaanus. bar bar hunchha bhane doctor ra counsellor dubai sanga salah linus, yo upachar hune samasya ho.
kahile kahi aafulai sakaun jasto lagchha

yo kura bhannu bhayo, yo dherai himmat ko kaam ho, ra ma tapai ko kura gambhir rup ma sundai chhu. ahile nai najik ko kunai bharosa ko manchhe, parivar ki sathi lai bhannus ki tapai lai yasto lagirahechha, eklai nabasnus. afno chheu bata hani garna sakne saman tadha rakhnus. turuntai khatara jasto lage najik ko aspatal ma jaanus ki 100 ma phone garnus. tapai ko jiwan mahatwapurna chha, ra yo bhawana ko upachar ra sahayog paainchha.
shahar ma aayera eklo lagchha, kohi chineko chhaina

naya shahar ma suru ma eklo lagnu swabhabik ho. hapta ma ek din kunai samuha ma judnus: khel, swayamsewa, dharmik thau ki sikne class. office ki college ma ek jana lai chiya khana bolaunus. ghar ko manchhe sanga niyamit kura garnus, ani bistarai yo shahar pani afno lagna thalchha.
aafu ma confidence nai chhaina

confidence ek palta mai aaudaina, sano sano kaam pura garda bistarai banchha. din ma euta sano lakshya rakhnus ra pura gare chinha lagaunus. aafno ramro guna ra sakeko kaam ko list lekhnus, garo din ma padhnus. afulai hepne bhasha "ma ta sakdina" ko satta "ma sikdai chhu" bhanne baani banaunus.
fail hune dar le kei suru nai garna sakdina

dherai jana lai yo dar hunchha, tara suru nagarnu nai pakka asafalta ho. kaam lai sano tukra ma todnus, pahilo tukra ma galti bhaye pani thulo farak pardaina. "nabhaye k sikchhu?" bhanne prashna sodhnus, harek prayas le kehi sikauchha. euta sathi lai afno lakshya bhannus, sahayog ra himmat dubai milchha.
kasai le aalochana garda dherai naramro lagchha

aalochana sunda naramro lagnu swabhabik ho. turuntai jawaf nadinus, ek din sochnus: yasma sachcha kura kati chha? kaam lagne kura linus ra baki chhodnus. aalochana tapai ko kaam ko barema ho, tapai ko pura moolya ko barema haina. ramro aalochana garne le prayah tapai ko sudhar chahanchhan.
padhai ma motivation nai harayo

kina padhdai hunuhunchha bhanne thulo karan euta kagaj ma lekhnus ra table chheu tasnus. lakshya lai sano banaunus: aaja 1 chapter matra. padhepachhi chinha lagaune calendar rakhnus, lagatar chinha le himmat dinchha. motivation sadhai hudaina, tyasaile niyamit samaya ko baani nai sabai bhanda bharpardo ho.
kaam le ekdam thakaayo, burnout jasto

lamo samaya aaram bina kaam garda sharir ra man dubai thakchhan. sakchhu bhane kehi din ko chhutti linus ra tyo bela kaam ko phone ra email nahernus. din ko kaam pachhi screen bina ko samaya, hidaai ra ramro nidra rakhnus. manager sanga kaam ko bojh ko barema imandar kura garnus. dherai hapta samma kehi pani ramro nalagne bhayo bhane doctor ki counsellor sanga kura garnus.
bachcha haru sanga ekdam ris uthchha ani karaunchhu

thakai ra tanab le dherai jaso ris chhito uthchha, tapai naramro aama buwa hunuhunna. ris uthda 10 second chup lagnus ra gahiro saas linus, chahiye arko kotha ma 1 minet jaanus. karaye pachhi bachcha lai "maile karaunu hunthena, sorry" bhannus, bachcha le pani maafi magna sikchhan. aafno lagi pani sano aaram ko samaya khojnus.
night shift ma kaam garchhu, diuso nidra lagdaina

diuso sutne kotha lai andhyaro banaunus, mota parda ki aankha ma patti prayog garnus. phone silent garnus ra ghar ka manchhe lai sutne samaya bataunus. shift sakepachhi ghar aaunda dherai ujyalo bata bachna chashma lagaunus. har din ekai samaya ma sutne koshish garnus, chhutti ko din pani dherai nabadlinus.
gym ko pahilo din pachhi jiu sabai dukhyo

naya exercise pachhi 1-2 din maansapeshi dukhnu samanya ho, yo bistarai thik hunchha. halka hidaai ra stretching le aaram dinchha, pura aaram bhanda halka chalan ramro. pani ra protein bhayeko khana khanus. arko palta weight ali kam garnus ra suru ma warm up garnus. joint ma tikho dukhai ki sujan bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
exercise agadi warm up kina garnu parchha?

warm up le maansapeshi taato banauchha ra mutu ko gati bistarai badhauchha, chot lagne sambhavana ghatchha. 5-10 minet halka daud, haat khutta ghumaune ra jiu tanne garnus. chiso bihana ma jhan jaruri hunchha. exercise sakepachhi pani 5 minet bistarai hidera sharir shanta banaunus.
raati dhilo khana khanda pet bhari hunchha, nidra aaudaina

sutne bela bhanda kamti 2-3 ghanta agadi khana khane koshish garnus. raati ko khana halka rakhnus, tel ra piro kam. khana pachhi 10 minet hidnus, pachna sahayog hunchha. dhilo hune bhaye beluka 5-6 baje tira sano khaja khanus, raati dherai bhok lagdaina.
energy drink piunu thik ho padhda?

energy drink ma dherai chini ra caffeine hunchha, mutu ko dhadkan badhaune, nidra bigarne ra pachhi jhan thakai dine hunchha. sakesamma napiunus, khas gari kishor umer ma. padhda thakai lage pani, halka khaja ra 5 minet ko hidaai ramro upaya ho. raati ko ramro nidra nai sabai bhanda ramro "energy" ho.
protein powder khanu parchha gym jaanda?

dherai jaso manchhe lai sadharan khana bata nai pugne protein paainchha: dal, chana, anda, dudh, dahi ra masu. powder jaruri haina, matra sajilo bikalpa ho. linu bhaye ramro brand ra sahi matra matra linus. mirgaula ki kunai rog bhaye doctor sanga sodhera matra linus.
vitamin ko chakki khanu ramro ho?

santulit khana khane dherai jaso manchhe lai chakki chahindaina. kunai vitamin ko kami chha ki chhaina bhanne ragat jaanch le thaha hunchha. doctor ko salah bina lamo samaya samma dherai matra ma vitamin khanu ramro haina. garbhawati, budhabudhi ki kunai rog bhayeka le doctor sanga sodhera matra linus.
buwa le raksi chhodnu parne, kasari sahayog garne?

ris ma bhanda shanta ra maya ko bela kura garnus: "tapai ko swasthya ko chinta lagchha." raksi ghar ma narakhnus ra sangai garne arko ramailo kaam badhaunus. dherai pine manchhe le ekdam chhoda sharir ma garo lakshan aauna sakchha, tyasaile doctor ko salah ma chhodnu surakshit hunchha. ghar ma hinsa hunchha bhane afno suraksha pahila rakhnus ra madat magnus.
khaini ra gutkha ko baani chhodna chahanchhu

khaini ra gutkha le munh ko cancer sammako khatara badhauchha, chhodne nirnaya dherai ramro ho. chhodne din tokdinus ra ghar ko sabai packet phalnus. man lagda sukeko saunf, lwang ki chewing gum munh ma rakhnus. pahilo 2-3 hapta garo hunchha. munh ma seto ki rato daag, ghau niko nabhayeko bhaye turuntai doctor dekhaunus.
ghar mai dahi kasari jamaune?

dudh umalera manta taato hunjel chiso garnus, aunla rakhda sahna sakine jati. 1 litre dudh ma 1-2 chamcha purano dahi milayera ramrari chalaunus. bhaado chhopera nyano thau ma 6-8 ghanta nahallai rakhnus. jameko pachhi fridge ma rakhnus, ani tyahi dahi bata arko palta jamauna sakinchha.
paneer ghar mai banauna milchha?

milchha. 1 litre dudh umalnus ani aago ghatayera 2-3 chamcha kagati ko ras bistarai halnus, dudh phatepachhi pani chhuttinchha. sapha kapada ma chhanera chiso pani le pakhalnus, kagati ko swad janchha. kapada ma bandhera mathi gahrungo chij 1 ghanta rakhnus, paneer tayar hunchha.
pakauda tarda dherai tel khanchha

tel ramro taato bhayepachhi matra pakauda halnus, chiso tel ma pakauda le jhan dherai tel khanchha. ek palta dherai nahalnus, tel ko taap ghatchha. besan ko ghol ali bakla banaunus. tarepachhi kagaj ma rakhnus, bachi tel kagaj le sosera linchha.
gas chulo ko aago pahelo aauchha

aago pahelo ra dhuwa aaunu bhaneko burner ko pwal phohor bhayeko hunasakchha. chulo chiso bhayepachhi burner nikalera sabun pani le dhunus ra sano pin le pwal sapha garnus. ramrari sukaera matra jodnus. tyo pani nabhaye ki gas ko gandha aaye mistri bolaunus.
bacheko bhat pheri tatayera khana milchha?

milchha, tara pakaeko bhat lamo samaya khulla thau ma narakhnus. pakaeko 1-2 ghanta bhitra chiso garera fridge ma rakhnus ra 1 din bhitra khanus. tataunda bichma samma ramrari taato banaunus. ek palta tatayeko bhat pheri pheri natataunus.
mobile data chhito sakinchha

settings ma gayera kun app le dherai data khanchha hernus. app ko auto update lai wifi ma matra garne banaunus. facebook ra youtube ma video autoplay banda garnus ra video quality ali ghataunus. ghar ma wifi bhaye phone ko data banda gari wifi matra chalaunus.
computer ko sajilo shortcut haru bhana na

Ctrl + C le copy, Ctrl + V le paste ra Ctrl + Z le pachhillo kaam undo hunchha. Ctrl + S le file save hunchha, kaam gardai bela bela thichnus. Alt + Tab le khuleka window bich sarna milchha. yi panch wata sikna matra le pani kaam dherai chhito hunchha.
spam call dherai aauchha

chineko number bahek ka shanka lagne call ma kunai personal jankari nadinus. phone ko settings ma spam ki unknown call block garne suvidha on garnus. bar bar aaune number block garnus. lottery, inam ki account banda hune bhanne call sabai thagi hunasakchha.
"paisa 1 mahina ma dobar" bhanne scheme ma sathi le bolayo

yasto dherai jaso thagi hunchha, kunai pani sachcho lagani le 1 mahina ma paisa dobar gardaina. suru ma kehi jana lai nafa dinchhan taki aru lai tanna sakun, pachhi sabai ko paisa dubchha. naya sadasya bolaye kamisan paune bhanne kura pani khatara ko sanket ho. paisa nahalnus ra sathi lai pani samjhaunus.
bachcha lai paisa ko barema kasari sikaune?

euta khutruke dinus ra paune paisa ko kehi bhag bachauna sikaunus. kinmel ma sangai lagera mol tulana garna sikaunus. "chahine" ra "man pareko" ko farak sano udaharan le bujhaunus. bachat le kunai sano saman kine pachhi tyo khusi le baani pakka banauchha.
bihe ma dherai kharcha hune bho, kasari kam garne?

suru mai jamma budget tokdinus ra parivar sanga sahamati garnus. pahuna ko sankhya sabai bhanda thulo kharcha ho, list chhoto banaunus. bhoj, lugaa ra sajawat ma tulana garera matra book garnus. sapat liyera thulo bihe garnu bhanda sano ra dhukka ko bihe pachhi dherai ramro lagchha.
photocopy ra print pasal kholda chalchha?

school, college, sarkari karyalaya ki aspatal najik bhaye chalne sambhavana ramro hunchha. suru ma ramro photocopy machine, printer ra laminating machine pugchha. form bharne, online fee tirne jasta sewa thapda aamdani badhchha. machine ko marmat ra kagaj ko kharcha mol ma milaunus.
phalphul ko juice pasal kasto hola?

garmi ma ra bheed hune thau ma juice pasal ramro chalchha. sarsafai sabai bhanda mahatwapurna: sapha pani, sapha gilas ra taja phal. mausami phal prayog garda sasto ra mitho hunchha. jaado ma chiya ki suup jasta taato kura thapda barsha bhari aamdani hunchha.
dhaka ko kapada bunera bechna sakinchha?

sakinchha, dhaka nepal ko chinaari bhayeko le ghar bhitra ra bahira dubai maag chha. bunai ko gunastar ra design ma dhyan dinus, ramro kaam le nai mol dinchha. topi, shawl, jhola jasta sajilai bikne saman banaunus. sthaniya pasal, mela ra online page bata bechna suru garnus.
sathi le exam ma chit garna help maagchha

sathi lai naramro nagarna khojda pani yo kura ma "nai" bhannu thik ho, pakrinda dubai ko pariksha radda hunasakchha. namra bhayera bhannus: "exam ma ta sakdina, tara aaja beluka sangai padhaun." pariksha agadi padhai ma madat garna tayar hunus, tyo sachcho sahayog ho.
mero sathi ekdam udaas chha, k garne?

uslai sodhnus: "aajkal timi ali udaas dekhinchhau, kura garna man chha?" ani salah dinu bhanda pahila dhyan le sunnus. sangai hidna, khana khana jasto sano kaam ma bolaunus. lamo samaya udaas, khana nidra chhodeko ki afulai hani garne kura gare bharosa ko thulo manchhe ki bisheshagya lai jodna madat garnus.
sathi sadhai dhilo aauchha, parkhera wakka lagyo

shanta bhayera bhannus: "parkhida mero samaya janchha, arko palta samaya mai aaye ramro." bhetne samaya pakka garda 15 minet agadi ko bhannus. dherai dhilo bhaye kati samaya parkhine bhanne niyam banaunus, jastai 20 minet. yo kura ris ma haina, sajilo tarika le bhanda sathi le bujhchha.
mero best friend arko shahar sarchha, man naramro

najik ko sathi tadha janda dukha lagnu swabhabik ho. jaanu agadi sangai ramailo samaya bitaunus ra photo, yaad banaunus. hapta ma ek palta call garne din tokdinus. tadha bhaye pani sachcha mitrata tikchha, chad ma bhetne plan banaunus.
naya bachcha janmyo, raati sutna paidaina

naya bachcha bhayeko ghar ma suru ka hapta yestai hunchhan, tapai matra haina. bachcha sutda tapai pani sutne koshish garnus, ghar ko kaam pachhi garna milchha. raati ko palo ghar ka arko sadasya sanga baadnus. aafno khana ra pani nachhodnus. dherai udas ki aafulai sambhalna nasakne lagyo bhane swasthya karmi sanga kura garnus.
naya janmeko bachcha lai kati palta dudh khuwaune?

dherai jaso naya bachcha le din raati gari 8-12 palta dudh khanchha, bhok ko sanket herera khuwaunus. pahilo 6 mahina aama ko dudh matra ramro maninchha. bachcha ko pisab ra taul badhne kura le pugeko chha ki thaha hunchha. dudh nakhane, dherai sust hune ki jworo aaye turuntai swasthya karmi lai dekhaunus.
birami aama ko sewa garda ma afai thakisake

lamo samaya sewa garnu dherai garo kaam ho, thakai lagnu swabhabik ho. parivar ka aru sadasya sanga palo baadnus, eklai sabai naboknus. din ma kehi samaya afno lagi rakhnus, hidne, sutne ki kasai sanga kura garne. swasthya karmi bata sewa garne sajilo tarika siknus. tapai swastha rahanu bhayo bhane matra ramro sewa garna sakinchha.
thulo project chha, kaha bata suru garne thaha chhaina

pahila antim lakshya euta vakya ma lekhnus. ani tyaslai 5-10 wata sano kaam ma todnus ra har kaam ko miti rakhnus. sabai bhanda sajilo ki sabai bhanda pahila chahine kaam bata suru garnus. har hapta progress hernus ra chahiye yojana milaunus.
deadline najik aayo, kaam aadha matra bhayo

pahila baki kaam ko list banaunus ra sabai bhanda jaruri bhag chhannus. perfect banaune bhanda pura garne ma dhyan dinus. sakchhu bhane manager ki teacher lai pahila nai sthiti bhannus, antim din bhanda pahila. phone ra notification banda garera 50 minet kaam, 10 minet aaram ko chakra chalaunus.
lukla flight ma jaane, k jankari chahinchha?

lukla ko flight mausam le dherai dhilo ki radda hunchha, tyasaile yatra ma 1-2 din thap rakhnus. bihana chhito ko flight ma mausam prayah ramro hunchha. saman ko taul sima kam hunchha, airline sanga bujhnus. flight radda bhaye arko din ko lagi tayar rahanus, sabai kaam hatar ma narakhnus.
trek ma power bank ra phone ko charge kasari milaune?

thulo power bank boknus ra jaado ma power bank lai sutda slipping bag bhitra rakhnus, chiso le chhito charge sakinchha. phone ma airplane mode ra kam ujyalo rakhnus. kehi lodge ma paisa tirera charge garna milchha. offline naksa pahila nai download garera rakhnus.
gaun ma homestay ma basda k ma dhyan dine?

ghar ka manchhe ko niyam ra sanskriti ko sammaan garnus, jastai jutta kaha kholne, bhanchha ma jaane ki najaane sodhnus. photo khichnu agadi anumati linus. diyeko khana ko kadar garnus ra pani ra bijuli bachaunus. jaanda dhanyabad bhannus, sano sahayog ki upahar le sambandha ramro hunchha.
trek ma gaun ka kukur dekhda dar lagchha

kukur dekhda nadaudnus, daudda jhan pachhi lagchha. shanta bhayera bistarai hidnus ra sidha aankha ma nahernus. haat ma lauro bhaye ramro, tara nahirkaunus. kukur le tokyo bhane ghau sabun pani le 15 minet dhoyera sakesamma chhito rabies ko khop ko lagi swasthya sanstha jaanus.
bachcha haru sanga trek jaana milchha?

milchha, tara chhoto ra kam uchai ko trek bata suru garnus, jastai pahad ko 1-2 din ko bato. bachcha ko gati anusar hidnus ra bela bela aaram dinus. lekh lageko lakshan bachcha le bhanna nasakna sakchhan, chidchidaune, nakhane ki dherai sutne bhaye tala jharnus. nyano lugaa, khaja ra pani pugdo boknus.
ilam ghumna jaane, kati din chahinchha?

ilam bazaar, chiya bagan ra najik ka thau herna 2-3 din ramro hunchha. bihana ko suryoday herna antu danda tira raat basne plan banaunus. pahad ma bihana beluka chiso hunchha, halka jacket boknus. barsha ma bato ko awastha pahila bujhera matra yatra garnus.
janakpur garmi ma jaane, k sawdhani?

garmi ma terai ma ghaam ekdam charko hunchha, dupahar ma chhaya ma basnus ra bihana beluka ghumnus. pani ra jeevan jal boknus, topi ra halka kapas ko lugaa lagaunus. sadak ko khulla khana ra pani bata satark rahanus. janaki mandir jasta thau ma jutta kholnu parne bhayekale chappal ramro.
cycle ma lamo yatra garne, k tayari?

cycle ko brake, tyre ra chain jaanch garaunus ra puncture banaune saman boknus. helmet ra raati dekhine batti ki reflector lagaunus. din ma kati km jaane yojana yatharthik banaunus ra pani ra khaja pugdo boknus. thulo sadak ma bayan chheu ma chalaunus ra thulo gadi aaunda satark rahanus.
offline map kasari prayog garne trek ma?

internet hunda nai map app ma tyo kshetra ko naksa download garnus. trek ko bato pahila nai herera mukhya gaun ra lodge chinha lagaunus. GPS internet bina pani chalchha, tara battery khanchha, tyasaile bela bela matra kholnus. map sanga sangai sthaniya manchhe lai bato sodhnus.
trek ma toilet ra sarsafai kasari?

lodge ko toilet prayog garnus ra sangai toilet paper ra haat sapha garne sanitizer boknus. bahira jaanu paryo bhane pani ko srot bata kamti 50 m tadha jaanus ra phohor gaadnus ki bokera lyaunus. plastic ra phohor bato ma naphalnus, jhola ma rakhera tala lyaunus. sapha haat le khana khanda pet kharab hune khatara ghatchha.
trek ma pani kasari piune?

dhara ki khola ko pani sidhai napiunus. umaleko pani, filter ki purification chakki prayog garnus. plastic bottle kinnu bhanda bottle ma pani bharera shuddha garnu ramro, phohor pani kam hunchha. mathi chiso ma pyas kam lagchha, tara din bhari thorai thorai piirahanus.
retirement pachhi ke garne thaha chhaina

kaam chhutda suru ma khali lagnu swabhabik ho. din ko sano routine banaunus: bihana hidne, kehi padhne, ghar ko bagaincha. jiwan bhari ko anubhav aru lai sikaunus, jastai gaun ka bachcha lai padhaune ki samaj ko kaam. sathi ra parivar sanga niyamit bhetghat rakhnus.
sano kotha ma dherai saman, milauna sakina

pahila 1 barsha dekhi nachalayeko saman chhuttyaunus ra dinus ki bechnus. palang muni ra dhoka pachhadi ko thau box ra hook le prayog garnus. har saman ko afno thau tokdinus ra prayog pachhi tyahi rakhnus. din ma 10 minet milauna baani le kotha sadhai sapha rahanchha.
ghar ma musa dherai aaye

khana ra anna chhopera, hawa nachhirne bhaado ma rakhnus. bhuin ra bhanchha ma khana ko tukra nachhodnus ra phohor ko bhaado chhopnus. musa pasne pwal haru sil garnus. bish rakhda bachcha ra pashu lai khatara hunchha, sakesamma pinjada prayog garnus.
ghar ma barsha ma bhitta ma dhusi lagchha

kotha ma hawa ra ghaam aaune garnus, jhyal bela bela kholnus. bhijeko lugaa kotha bhitra nasukaunus. dhusi lageko thau sabun pani ra sukha kapada le puchhnus, ani ramrari sukaunus. chhana ki pipe bata pani chuheko chha bhane tyo marmat nagari samasya jaadaina.
geometry ko theorem prove garna aaudaina

pahila theorem ma k diyeko chha ra k prove garnu parchha chhuttai lekhnus. chitra aafai ramro sanga banaunus ra diyeko kura chitra ma chinha lagaunus. kitab ko proof lai 3-4 step ma todera bujhnus, ani kitab banda garera afai lekhnus. ekai theorem 3 palta lekhepachhi tarika dimag ma baschha.
chemistry ko equation balance garna garo

pahila sabai bhanda dherai atom bhayeko yaugik bata suru garnus. har tatva ko atom duitai tira gannus ra coefficient (agadi ko sankhya) matra badalnus, formula bhitra ko sano ank haina. oxygen ra hydrogen lai antim ma milaunus. din ma 5 wata equation abhyas garda 1 hapta ma sajilo hunchha.
essay lekhda idea nai aaudaina

lekhnu agadi 3 minet bishaya ko barema "k, kina, kasari, kasle" bhanne prashna sodhera jawaf tipnus. tyo nai essay ko anuchhed banchha. afno jiwan ko sano udaharan thapnus, padhne lai ramro lagchha. niyamit kitab ra lekh padhne baani le idea aafai badhchha.
padheko bujhchhu tara exam ma lekhna sakdina

padhda bujhnu ra afai lekhnu farak sip ho, tyasaile lekhne abhyas chahinchha. har chapter pachhi kitab banda garera 2-3 prashna ko uttar ghadi rakhera lekhnus. lekheko uttar kitab sanga milayera k chhutyo hernus. hapta ma ek palta purano paper lekhera abhyas garnus.
khel ra padhai dubai garna man chha, samaya milena

dubai garna sakinchha, khel le dimag lai taja banauchha. hapta ko taalika banaunus: bihana padhai, beluka 1 ghanta khel. khel pachhi thakai bhaye halka subject padhnus. exam najik aaunda khel ko samaya ali ghataunus tara pura nachhodnus.
teacher le sadhai aru bidyarthi lai matra maya garchhan jasto lagchha

yasto lagda naramro lagchha, tara kahile kahi teacher le dherai sodhne ra sakriya bidyarthi lai badhi dhyan dinchhan. class ma prashna sodhnus ra homework samaya mai bujhaunus. pheri pani anyay jasto lage aama buwa ki class teacher sanga shanta bhayera kura garnus.
class ma sabai bhanda kamjor chhu jasto lagchha

arko sanga tulana garnu bhanda hijo ko afu sanga tulana garnus. kun subject ma sabai bhanda garo chha, tyasko aadhar ko kura bata suru garnus. din ma 30 minet thap abhyas ra nabujheko kura sodhne baani le 2-3 mahina ma farak dekhinchha. sano sudhar pani sudhar nai ho.
chhori lai math dekhi dar lagchha

dar dherai jaso galti garda gali paune anubhav bata aauchha. ghar ma math lai khel jastai banaunus: pasal ma hisab, khana ma bhag baadne. galti garda gali nagarnus, "kaha bata galti bhayo, herau" bhannus. sajilo prashna bata suru gari sano safalta dinus, bharosa badhepachhi dar ghatchha.
online course suru garchhu tara bichai ma chhodchhu

course ko lagi hapta ko nishchit din ra samaya tokdinus, jastai sombar, budhabar ra shukrabar beluka 7 baje. ek palta ma euta video matra herne sano lakshya rakhnus. sikeko kura le sano project banaunus, kaam lagda josh badhchha. sathi sanga sangai course garda pani chhodne sambhavana ghatchha.
nursing padhne ki pharmacy, confuse

nursing ma birami ko sidhai sewa, aspatal ma shift ma kaam ra manchhe sanga dherai samparka hunchha. pharmacy ma aushadhi ko gyan, pasal, aspatal ki company ma kaam hunchha. tapai lai manchhe ko sewa garna man parchha ki vigyan ra aushadhi ko gyan? dubai kshetra ma kaam gardai gareka ek-ek jana sanga sodhda dherai kura spasta hunchha.
padhai chhodera kaam garna man chha, ghar ko arthik awastha ramro chhaina

ghar ko jimmewari sochnu ramro kura ho. sakchhu bhane padhai pura nachhodnus, kaam sangai padhna milne bato khojnus, jastai bihana ko college ki khula bishwabidyalaya. padhai le pachhi ramro kaam ra talab dina sakchha. ghar ka manchhe ra teacher sanga basera dubai bato ko faida ra bephaida herera nirnaya garnus.
bidesh padhna jaana consultancy le dherai paisa magyo

paisa dinu agadi consultancy sarkar ma darta chha ki chhaina ra purana bidyarthi ko anubhav bujhnus. college ko jankari tyas desh ko aadhikarik website ma afai jaanch garnus. sabai bhuktani ko rasid ra samjhauta lekhit linus. "visa pakka" bhanne kura ma bharosa nagarnus, visa ko nirnaya dutawas le matra garchha.
scholarship kasari khojne?

tapai padhna chahane college ra bishwabidyalaya ko website ma scholarship ko suchana hernus. sarkari, sthaniya palika ra sanstha haru le pani chhatravritti dinchhan, samachar ra suchana pati herdai garnus. form bharda marksheet, sifarish ra aawashyak kagaj pahila nai tayar rakhnus. antim miti bhanda agadi nai bujhaunus.
sutda dherai ghurchhu re

chit ko satta kolte pareko sutda ghurai prayah kam hunchha. sutnu agadi raksi ra bhari khana kam garnus, ani taul badhi bhaye alikati ghataunda farak parchha. naak banda bhaye baph linus. sutda saas rokine jasto, bihana taauko dukhne ki din bhari ekdam nidra lagne bhaye doctor sanga salah linus.
khana khaye pachhi pet phulchha

bistarai ra ramrari chapayera khanus, chhito khanda hawa dherai nilinchha. chiso peya, dherai tareko khana ra ek palta dherai khana kam garnus. khana pachhi 10 minet halka hidnus. pet dukhai, bomit, taul ghatne ki lamo samaya samma rahirahe doctor dekhaunus.
kahile kahi mutu chhito dhadkinchha

chiya, coffee ra energy drink kam garnus, ani tanab ra kam nidra pani karan hunasakchha. dhadkan chhito hunda basera bistarai gahiro saas linus. tara chhati dukhne, saas phulne, chakkar lagne ki behos jasto bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus. bar bar hunchha bhane doctor le ECG jasto jaanch garna sakchhan.
ochhyan bata uthda chakkar lagchha

ekai choti jhatta naudhnus: pahila basnus, 1 minet pachhi bistarai ubhinus. din bhari pani pugne gari piunus. kahile kahi pressure ghatda ki ragat ko kami le pani yasto hunchha. bar bar hunchha, khasnu bhayo ki behos bhaye doctor sanga jaanch garaunus.
haat khutta jhamjhamauchha, sunnine jasto

dherai bera ekai tarika le basda ki sutda yasto kahile kahi hunchha, uthera halka chalnus. tara bar bar hunchha, lamo samaya rahanchha ki kamjori sangai hunchha bhane doctor dekhaunus, sugar ki vitamin ko kami jasta karan jaanch garna parchha. achanak ek tira ko jiu sunnine, bolna garo bhaye turuntai aspatal jaanus.
pisab garda polchha

pani dherai piunus ra pisab lamo samaya rokera nabasnus. sapha sutira lugaa lagaunus ra toilet pachhi agadi bata pachhadi tira sapha garnus. tara polne lakshan dherai jaso sankraman ko hunasakchha, doctor dekhayera jaanch garaunu ramro. jworo, kammar dukhne ki pisab ma ragat bhaye chhito jaanus.
aankha rato bhayo, kichra aauchha

aankha nakanyaunus ra sapha pani le bistarai dhunus. haat bela bela sabun le dhunus ra afno rumal, towel ra takiya aru sanga baadnus. aankha phulne rog sarne hunasakchha, kehi din school ki kaam ma sansarga kam garnus. dukhai, dhamilo dekhine ki 2-3 din ma farak naparne bhaye aankha ko doctor dekhaunus.
jiu ma gol gol chilaune daag aayo

tyo dabbar jasto fungus ko sankraman hunasakchha. thau sukha ra sapha rakhnus, pasina aaye chhito lugaa fernus. afno towel ra lugaa aru sanga naprayog garnus. pharmacist ki doctor sanga sodhera sahi malam linus, ra niko bhaye jasto lage pani bhaneko jati din lagaunus.
munh bata gandha aauchha

din ma 2 palta daat majhnus ra jibro pani sapha garnus, gandha ko thulo karan jibro ma hunchha. khana pachhi kulla garnus ra pani dherai piunus. daat ko bich ma phasne khana floss le nikalnus. ramro sarsafai pachhi pani gandha rahirahe dentist dekhaunus, daat ki gija ko samasya hunasakchha.
jado ma oth phutchha

oth chatne baani chhodnus, jhan sukchha. lip balm, ghiu ki vaseline din ma dherai palta lagaunus, sutnu agadi pani. pani dherai piunus. ragat aaune gari phuteko bhaye pani ghau niko nahunjel tikho ra piro khana kam garnus.
naya jutta le khutta ma pota aayo

pota nafodnus, bhitra ko chhala le sankraman bata bachauchha. sapha garera halka patti lagaunus ra kehi din tyo jutta nalagaunus. pota aafai phutyo bhane sapha pani le dhoyera antiseptic lagaunus. naya jutta suru ma ghar mai kehi ghanta lagayera khukulo banaunus.
chhora ko school jhola ekdam bhari, kammar dukhchha re

jhola ko taul bachcha ko taul ko 10% jati bhanda badhi nahunu ramro bhanchhan. dinko timetable anusar kitab matra rakhne baani sikaunus. jhola dubai kandh ma bokne ra strap milayera jiu najik rakhnus. dukhai lamo samaya rahyo bhane doctor dekhaunus ra school sanga pani kura garnus.
2 barsha ko bachcha phone matra herchha

sano bachcha lai screen kam bhanda kam dinu ramro bhanchhan. phone ko satta kitab ko chitra, khelauna, gaana ra bahira khelne samaya dinus. khana khuwauda phone dekhaune baani bistarai chhodnus. tapai le pani bachcha agadi phone kam chalaunus, bachcha thulo ko nakkal garchhan.
bachcha ko taul dherai badhyo

bachcha lai "mota" bhanera gali nagarnus, man ma chot laagchha. ghar ma chiso peya, chauchau ra packet ko khaja kam rakhnus, phal ra tarkari badhaunus. din ma kamti 1 ghanta daudne khelne samaya dinus, sakchhu bhane sangai khelnus. bachcha ko doctor sanga taul ra uchai jaanch garaunus.
aushadhi ko expiry date nai gaisakeko chha, khana milchha?

expiry date nagheko aushadhi nakhanus, kehi aushadhi ko asar ghatchha ra kehi bigrina sakchhan. tyasta aushadhi bachcha le napaune gari phalnus. ghar ko aushadhi ek thau ma rakhnus ra barsha ma 2 palta jaanch garnus. jaruri aushadhi sakina agadi naya lyaunus.
antibiotic 3 din khaye, thik bhayo, aba chhodne?

doctor le bhaneko jati din pura khanus, niko bhaye jasto lage pani. bichai ma chhodda rog farkina sakchha ra aushadhi le kaam nagarne kitanu banna sakchha. kehi samasya ki side effect bhaye afai nachhodi doctor ki pharmacist lai sodhnus.
sano sano rog ma pasal bata afai aushadhi kinera khanchhu

kehi sadharan aushadhi pharmacist sanga sodhera linu thik hunchha, tara antibiotic ra pressure, sugar jasta aushadhi doctor ko salah bina nakhanus. galat aushadhi ki galat matra le jhan hani garna sakchha. 2-3 din ma niko nabhaye ki lakshan badhe doctor dekhaunus.
office ma basera garna milne exercise?

har ghanta ma kursi bata uthera 2 minet hidnus. basera nai kandh ghumaune, ghaati bistarai dayan bayan garne ra haat mathi tanne garnus. pani piuna afai uthera jaanus ra lift ko satta bharyang prayog garnus. sano chalan le pani din bhari ko thakai kam garchha.
garbhawati bela exercise garna milchha?

dherai jaso swastha garbhawati mahila lai halka hidaai ra sajilo stretching ramro hunchha, tara pahila afno doctor sanga sodhnus. lado ra pet ma dabab parne exercise nagarnus. thakai lagda turuntai aaram garnus ra pani piunus. ragat bagne, pet dukhne ki chakkar lagne bhaye exercise rokera doctor kaha jaanus.
daudna ko lagi kasto jutta kinne?

naram talo bhayeko ra khutta lai ramro samatne running jutta kinnus, chappal ki kada jutta haina. beluka khutta ali phuleko bela kinda size sahi aauchha. jutta lagayera pasal mai ali hidnus, aunla ko agadi alikati thau hunu parchha. dherai mahango hunu pardaina, aaram dayak hunu mukhya ho.
raati bhat khanda mota hunchha re, sahi ho?

raati bhat khanu matra le mota hudaina, din bhari jamma kati khanuhunchha ra kati chalnuhunchha tyo mukhya ho. raati dherai bhat ra sutne bela samma khana khane baani le chai taul badhna sakchha. raati thorai bhat, dherai tarkari ra dal khanus ani sutnu bhanda 2-3 ghanta agadi khanus.
ma momo dherai khanchhu, naramro ho?

momo kahile kahi khanu ramrai ho, tyasma masu, tarkari ra pitho sabai hunchha. tara har din, khas gari tareko ki fried momo, khanda tel ra nun badhi hunchha. steam momo chhannus ra sangai tarkari ko jhol ki salad khanus. hapta ma 1-2 palta bhaye santulit hunchha.
gundruk khanu ramro ho?

gundruk nepal ko paramparik khana ho ra sag ko poshak tatva ra amilo swad dinchha. gundruk ko jhol bhat sanga khanda bhok pani ramro lagchha. tara nun ra achar sangai dherai nahalnus. sapha tarika le banako ra ramrari sukayeko gundruk prayog garnus.
sano bhai lai jealous feel hunchha, aama le badhi maya garchhan jasto

yasto lagnu dherai jana lai hunchha, ra yo kura bhannu nai ramro ho. aama lai shanta bela ma bhannus: "kahile kahi malai pani tapai sanga eklai samaya chahinchha." aama sanga hapta ma euta sano samaya, jastai sangai bajar jaane, rakhna sakinchha. bhai sano bhayeko le usko herchah badhi chahinchha, tara tapai pratiko maya kam bhayeko haina.
purano relationship birsana sakiraheko chhaina

birsana samaya lagchha, ra yo samaya ma dukha lagnu swabhabik ho. purano message ra photo baram baram hernu bhanda kehi samaya ko lagi tadha rakhnus. naya kaam, khel ki sathi sanga samaya bitaunus. afno barema ramro sochnus, yo antya le tapai ko moolya ghataudaina.
sathi ko bihe ma jaana paisa chhaina, lajja lagchha

bihe ma upahar bhanda tapai ko upasthiti ra shubhakamana mahatwapurna ho. sano tara man bata diyeko upahar, jastai photo frame ki ramro shubhakamana patra, pani pugchha. jaana nai nasakne bhaye sathi lai sidhai bhannus ra pachhi bhetera badhai dinus. sachcha sathi le bujhchha.
aafantu le sadhai "kahile bihe? kahile jagir?" bhanchhan

yasta prashna le dabab dinchha, tara dherai jaso unle chinta le sodheka hunchhan. muskurayera chhoto jawaf tayar rakhnus: "samaya aaye pachhi bhanchhu ni!" ani kura arko bishaya ma laijaanus. tapai ko jiwan ko samaya tapai nai tokne ho, aru ko time table le haina.
sathi haru ko talab mero bhanda dherai, naramro lagchha

arko ko talab sanga tulana garda santushti harauchha, har kaam ko bato farak hunchha. afno kaam ma k sikdai hunuhunchha ra 2-3 barsha ma kaha pugna chahanu hunchha, tyasma dhyan dinus. talab badhaune skill ki certificate siknus. ani bachat ra kharcha ko yojana le pani thulo farak parchha.
phone garna dar lagchha, office ko kaam ma pani

phone garnu agadi bhanne kura ko 2-3 bunda kagaj ma lekhnus. suru ko vakya tayar rakhnus: "namaste, ma ... bata bolchhu, ... ko barema sodhna phone gareko." pahila sajilo phone, jastai chineko manchhe lai, bata abhyas garnus. har phone pachhi dar alikati ghatchha.
budhyauli ma eklo lagchha, chhora chhori bidesh

eklo lagnu swabhabik ho, tara sano kadam le farak parchha. bihana gaun ki tol ka sathi sanga hidne, mandir ki samaj ko karyakram ma jaane garnus. chhora chhori sanga hapta ko nishchit din video call garnus, phone chalauna sikna sakinchha. bagaincha ki sano kaam le din ma artha dinchha.
pahilo salary aayo, k garne?

badhai chha! pahila sano bhag aama buwa ko lagi kehi kinidinus, tyo khusi ko kura ho. talab ko 10-20% bachat ma chhuttyaunus ra emergency fund ko suruwat garnus. baki kharcha ko yojana banaunus. pahilo talab bata ramro baani suru garda pachhi sajilo hunchha.
buwa sanga pocket money badhauna kasari bhanne?

shanta bela ma kura garnus ra kina chahinchha spasta bhannus, jastai yatayat ra khaja ko kharcha badhyo. ek mahina ko kharcha lekhera dekhaunus, buwa lai bharosa hunchha. "ma bachat pani garchhu" bhanera sano bachat ko yojana pani bhannus. jawaf "hudaina" aaye pani namra rahanus.
bihe ma upahar ma kati paisa dine?

yo tapai ko kamai ra sambandha anusar farak hunchha, aru le kati diyo bhanera dabab naliunus. mahina ko budget ma bihe ra chad ko lagi pahila nai sano rakam chhuttyaunus. najik ko aafantu ra sathi lai ali badhi ra aru lai sanketik upahar dinu thik ho. maya ra shubhakamana nai mukhya ho.
bima ko claim garda ke kagaj chahinchha?

sabai bhanda pahila bima company lai turuntai khabar garnus, kati din bhitra bhanne niyam hunchha. policy number, aspatal ko bill, doctor ko report ra parichaya patra ko copy tayar rakhnus. sabai kagaj ko photocopy afu sanga rakhnus. bujhena bhane company ko agent ki karyalaya ma sidhai sodhnus.
bidesh ma 3 barsha basera 20 lakh bachaune lakshya chha

3 barsha ma 20 lakh bhaneko mahina ma lagbhag 55-56 hajar bachat chahinchha, pahila tyo sambhav chha ki hernus. har mahina talab aaune bittikai bachat ko rakam ghar ki bank ma pathaunus. ghar ko kharcha ra afno kharcha ko spasta sima banaunus. ani paisa kaha lagaune bhanne yojana pani pahila nai banaunus.
byabasaya ko lagi bank loan line soch, k tayari?

pahila lekhit yojana banaunus: kati paisa chahinchha, k ma lagaune, mahina ko aamdani ra kista kasari tirne. 2-3 bank ko byaj dar ra niyam tulana garnus. kista tirna nasake k hunchha bhanne bujhnus. sakesamma sano loan bata suru garnus ra byabasaya chalepachhi badhaunus.
chhori ko naam ma bachat khata kholne?

ramro bichar! dherai bank ma bachcha ko naam ma khata kholna milchha, janma darta ra aama buwa ko parichaya patra chahinchha. har mahina sano rakam niyamit halnus. bachcha thulo hudai gaye uslai pani khata ko barema sikaunus, paisa ko gyan sano bela dekhi suru hunchha.
nagad ki digital payment, kun ramro?

dubai ko afnai faida chha. digital payment sajilo ra hisab rakhna sajilo hunchha, tara PIN ra OTP surakshit rakhnu parchha. nagad le kharcha ko sima mahsus garauchha ra internet bina pani chalchha. dainik kharcha ko lagi sano nagad ra thulo bhuktani ko lagi digital, yasto milayera chalaunu ramro.
tarkari pasal ma nafa kam hunchha

tarkari chhito bigrine bhayekale noksan kam garnu nai nafa ho. bihana taja tarkari matra lyaunus ra hijo ko tarkari beluka sasto ma bechnus. kun tarkari kati bikchha lekhnus ra tyasai anusar lyaunus. pasal sapha ra tarkari sapha dekhine gari rakhda grahak badhchhan.
haat le banako saman ko mol kati rakhne?

pahila lagat nikalnus: kachcha saman, samaya ra yatayat. afno samaya ko pani mol gannus, natra kaam ko kadar hudaina. tyas mathi uchit nafa thapnus ra bajar ma tyastai saman ko mol hernus. ekdam sasto rakhda gunastar ma shanka garchhan, ramro kaam ko uchit mol rakhnus.
grahak le online ma naramro review lekhyo

ris ma jawaf nadinus. namra bhayera sarvajanik jawaf dinus: "tapai lai asajilo bhayeko ma dukha lagyo, kripaya sampark garnus, samadhan garchhau." ani sachchai samasya sudharnus. ramro sanga samadhan garda aru grahak le pani tapai ko imandari dekhchhan.
sathi sanga milera byabasaya garne, k dhyan dine?

suru mai lekhit samjhauta garnus: kasle kati lagani, kasko k kaam, nafa noksan kasari baadne ra chhodna parda k garne. paisa ko hisab spasta ra dubai le herna milne gari rakhnus. mahina ma ek palta basera kura garnus. sathi bhaye pani niyam spasta bhaye nai mitrata ra byabasaya dubai bachchhan.
mobile repair sikna kaha bata suru garne?

pahila najik ko training centre ki anubhavi mistri sanga sikne mauka khojnus. suru ma screen, battery ra charging port ferna sikna, yahi kaam dherai aauchha. ramro aujar ra sapha kaam garne thau chahinchha. grahak ko phone ko data ra jankari ko gopaniyata rakhnu nai bharosa ko mul ho.
kheti ma compost mal kasari banaune?

bhanchha ko tarkari ko bokra, sukeko paat ra gobar ek khalto ma tah tah gari halnus. bela bela alikati pani chharkera chiso rakhnus tara dherai bhijauna nadinus. 2-3 hapta ma ek palta ulto paltaunus, hawa jaos. 2-3 mahina ma kalo, mato jasto gandha aaune mal tayar hunchha.
naya laptop kinda k herne?

kaam anusar chhannus: padhai ra office ko lagi kamti 8 GB RAM ra SSD bhayeko laptop chhito chalchha. battery ko samaya, taul ra screen ko size pani hernus. warranty ra najik ma service centre chha ki bujhnus. mahango brand bhanda tapai ko kaam lai pugne ra bharosa ko pasal bata kinnu ramro.
phone ma jata pani ad aauchha, virus ho?

haalai install gareko app ma shanka garnus, kehi app le jata pani ad dekhauchhan. settings ma gayera nachineko ra nachalaune app hataunus. app ko permission hernus, "display over other apps" jasto permission chahine nabhayeko app bata hataunus. app official store bata matra download garnus.
phone ko photo dhamilo aauchha

pahila camera ko lens sapha naram kapada le puchhnus, haat ko chhap le photo dhamilo hunchha. photo khichda phone sthir rakhnus ra screen ma thichera focus garnus. ujyalo kam bhaye jhyal najik ki ujyalo thau ma khichnus. tyo pani nabhaye camera app ko cache clear garnus ki phone restart garnus.
whatsapp ko message ra photo backup kasari?

whatsapp ko settings ma "chats" ma gayera "chat backup" kholnus. google drive ki iCloud ma backup garna milchha, wifi ma garda data bachchha. kahile kahile automatic backup garne bhanne pani tokna sakinchha. naya phone ma whatsapp kholda tyahi number ra account le backup restore garnus.
zoom meeting ma pahilo palta, k dhyan dine?

meeting agadi app ma microphone ra camera ek palta jaanch garnus. shanta thau ra anuhar ma ujyalo pardine gari basnus. aafu nabolda mic mute garnus. 5 minet agadi join garnus, internet ko samasya bhaye milauna samaya hunchha.
computer on hune bittikai dherai dhilo hunchha

computer suru hunda aafai khulne program dherai bhaye dhilo hunchha. task manager ma "startup" ma gayera nachaine program banda garnus. nachalaune software hataunus ra disk ma kamti 15-20% thau khali rakhnus. purano hard disk bhaye SSD halda dherai chhito hunchha.
pendrive lagaye pachhi file haru harayo, shortcut matra dekhinchha

yo dherai jaso virus ko kaam ho, file lukeko matra hunasakchha. pendrive ma kehi naya file nahalnus. antivirus le pendrive scan garnus. ani file explorer ma "hidden items" dekhaune banayera file chha ki hernus. mahatwapurna file bhaye jankaar ko madat linus.
bachcha lai youtube ma k herna dine?

sano bachcha ko lagi "YouTube Kids" jasto bachcha ko app ra parental control prayog garnus. bachcha le herne bela tapai pani najik basnus ra k herdai chha thaha paunus. siksha, gaana ra kahani ko video chhannus. samaya sima rakhnus, jastai din ko 30 minet.
online class ma mero mic le kaam gardaina

pahila app ma mic mute chha ki hernus. phone ki computer ko settings ma tyo app lai microphone ko permission diyeko chha ki jaanch garnus. earphone lagayera try garnus, kahile kahi earphone ko mic le kaam garchha. tyo pani nabhaye app band garera pheri kholnus ki device restart garnus.
interview ma nervous le haat kampchha

interview agadi 5 minet bistarai gahiro saas linus: 4 second bhitra, 6 second bahira. haat table mathi ki kakh ma shanta rakhnus, kalam samatda kamp kam dekhinchha. pahila ghar ma sathi sanga mock interview garnus. nervous hunu le tapai lai yo kaam chahinchha bhanne dekhauchha, interviewer le pani bujhchhan.
job offer letter ma k k herne?

talab, kaam ko pad ra jimmewari, kaam ko samaya ra chhutti ko niyam ramro sanga padhnus. probation kati samaya ra tyo bela ko niyam k ho hernus. bima, sanchaya kosh jasta suvidha chha ki bujhnus. nabujheko kura HR lai sodhnus ani matra sahi garnus.
probation period ma k garne?

yo samaya ma tapai ko kaam ra byabahar le bharosa banchha. samaya mai aaunus, kaam samaya mai sakaunus ra galti bhaye turuntai bhannus. manager sanga bela bela "mero kaam kasto chha?" bhanera feedback magnus. naya kura sikne ichchha dekhaunus.
office ma politics dherai chha, k garne?

gossip ma nabasnus ra kasaiko kura arko lai nalagaunus. afno kaam ramro sanga ra imandar bhayera garnus, kaam nai sabai bhanda baliyo suraksha ho. sabai sanga namra byabahar rakhnus tara gopya kura sabai lai nabhannus. kehi galat ki anyay bhaye pramad sahit manager ki HR lai bhannus.
colleague le afno kaam ma pani malai lagauchha

namra tara spasta bhannus: "aaja mero afnai kaam baki chha, tapai ko kaam garna sakdina." sadhai "hunchha" bhanda bojh badhdai janchha. dherai bhaye manager sanga kaam ko bhagbanda spasta garna sodhnus. madat garnu ramro ho, tara afno kaam bigrine gari haina.
30 barsha ma career badalna dhilo bhayo?

dhilo bhayena, dherai jana le 30 pachhi naya kshetra suru garchhan. pahila naya kshetra ma kaam gardai gareka manchhe sanga kura garnus ra ke skill chahinchha bujhnus. ahile ko kaam chhodnu agadi sangai sikne, jastai beluka ki weekend ma course. thorai bachat rakhera matra parivartan garnus.
CV ma 2 barsha ko gap chha, k lekhne?

gap lukauna nakhojnus, imandar bhayera chhoto karan lekhnus, jastai parivar ko herchah ki padhai. tyo samaya ma sikeka kura, jastai course, swayamsewa ki ghar ko byabasaya, thapnus. interview ma sodhe shanta bhayera bhannus ra aba kaam ko lagi tayar bhayeko kura jod dinus.
CV ma reference kaslai rakhne?

tapai ko kaam ki padhai najik bata dekheko manchhe rakhnus, jastai purano manager, supervisor ki shikshak. aafantu ra sathi narakhnus. reference rakhnu agadi unko anumati linus ra unko pad, phone ra email sahi lekhnus. unlai tapai le kun kaam ko lagi apply gareko pani bataunus.
english ma aayeko email ko jawaf kasari dine?

suru ma "Dear ..." ki "Hello ..." ra dhanyabad: "Thank you for your email." tyas pachhi uniharu le sodheka kura ko jawaf chhoto anuchhed ma dinus. kehi pathaunu chha bhane "Please find attached ..." lekhnus. antya ma "Best regards" ra afno naam lekhnus.
english movie subtitle bina bujhna chahanchhu

pahila english subtitle sanga hernus, ani man parne scene subtitle bina pheri hernus. dherai bolne ra sajilo bhasha bhayeko cartoon ki family movie bata suru garnus. naya shabda ra vakya copy ma tipnus. bistarai subtitle hataudai jaanus, 3-6 mahina ma dherai farak dekhinchha.
english ma interview dinu chha, dar lagchha

sambhawit prashna ko list banaunus, jastai "Tell me about yourself" ra "Why this job?" ra uttar english ma lekhnus. tyo uttar ratnu bhanda mukhya bunda yaad garera bolne abhyas garnus. aina agadi ki phone ma record garera sunnus. bujhena bhane "Could you please repeat the question?" bhannu thik ho.
english novel padhna suru garna chahanchhu

sajilo bhasha ra chhoto kitab bata suru garnus, jastai bachcha ra kishor ko lagi lekhieka katha. pura shabda bujhnu pardaina, katha bujhe pugchha. din ma 5-10 pana padhne lakshya rakhnus. dherai dohorine shabda matra dictionary ma hernus.
sathi le aafno birthday party ma bolayena

bolayena bhanda naramro lagnu swabhabik ho. kahile kahi thau ki budget ko karan le sano party gareko pani hunasakchha. sakchhu bhane shanta bhayera sodhnus: "malai bolaunu bhayena, kei bhayo ki?" uttar sunera matra nirnaya garnus. ek palta le pura mitrata napinus.
best friend lai naya sathi bhayo, malai bewasta garchha

sathi ko naya sathi bhayo bhanda dar lagnu swabhabik ho. tara sathi le dui jana lai maya garna sakchha. sidhai bhannus: "aajkal hamro samaya kam bhayo, timi sanga samaya bitauna man lagchha." sakchhu bhane naya sathi sanga pani chinjaan garnus, kahile kahi tinai jana ramro sathi banna sakinchha.
bhai le mero phone sodhdai nasodhai chalauchha

phone ma lock rakhnus ra bhai lai shanta bhayera bhannus: "phone ma mero kaam ra gopya kura hunchha, sodhera matra chalau." kahile kahi tapai sanga basera chalauna dinus, uslai pani chahine kura bujhnus. ghar ma aama buwa sanga milayera bhai ko lagi samaya ko niyam banauna sakinchha.
aama buwa sadhai jhagada garnu hunchha, dar lagchha

ghar ma jhagada sunda dar lagnu swabhabik ho, ra yo tapai ko galti haina. jhagada ko bela arko kotha ma gayera geet sunne ki padhne garnus. shanta bela ma kunai ek jana sanga "tapai haru jhagada garda malai dar lagchha" bhannus. kut pit ki surakshit nalagne bhaye aafantu, teacher ki 100 ma sampark garnus.
chhora bidesh jaane bhanchha, aama ko rup ma dar lagchha

chhora tadha jaane kura le chinta lagnu swabhabik ho. usko yojana sanga basera bujhnus: kun desh, kun kaam, kun company ra karar ma k chha. darta bhayeko manpower ra kagajpatra jaanch garna sahayog garnus. dar ko satta sahayog dekhauda chhora le pani khulera kura garchha.
didi le sadhai malai hukum garchhin

didi lai tapai ko herchah garne baani bhayeko hunasakchha. shanta bela ma bhannus: "malai pani afnai nirnaya garna dinu na, sallah chahiye ma sodhchhu." didi ko ramro kura ko kadar pani garnus. jhagada ko bela haina, ramro bela kura garda didi le chhito bujhchhin.
buwa sanga jhagada bhayo, 3 din dekhi bolnu hunna

buwa ko man pani dukheko hunasakchha. pahila tapai le shanta bhayera bolnus: "buwa, tyo din maile tyasari bhannu hunthena." sano kaam ma madat garnus, jastai chiya banaidine, bolchal sajilai suru hunchha. galti dubai tira bhaye pani pahila bolne manchhe sano hudaina.
hajurba lai phone ma video call garna sikaune

phone ma video call ko app ko icon home screen mai thulo gari rakhnus. "yo hariyo button thichnu, ani camera ko chinha" jasto sajilo bhasha ma bhannus. 2-3 palta sangai abhyas garnus ra kagaj ma step lekhera phone chheu rakhnus. bistarai sikdai jaanu hunchha, dhairya rakhnus.
padhai, ghar ko kaam ra part-time job, sabai garo

hapta ko taalika banaunus ra har kaam ko nishchit samaya tokdinus. ghar ko kaam ma parivar sanga baadfaad garnus. bus ma ki khali samaya ma chhoto revision garnus. sabai kura perfect garna sakidaina, sabai bhanda jaruri kura chhannus ra afno nidra nachhodnus.
phone ma dherai app, samaya barbad hunchha

1 mahina samma nachalayeko app hataunus. social media ra game ko app home screen bata hatayera folder bhitra rakhnus, kholna ali garo hos. app ko notification banda garnus. phone ma "screen time" herdai hapta ma kati samaya gayo hernus.
weekend ko plan kasari banaune, sadhai barbad hunchha

shukrabar beluka nai 2-3 wata kaam ra 1-2 wata ramailo kura lekhnus. shanibar bihana jaruri kaam sakaunus, diuso ramailo ko lagi rakhnus. ek din ma sabai kaam nathupnus, aaram ko samaya pani plan ma rakhnus. aaitabar beluka arko hapta ko halka tayari garnus.
aalu kauli ko tarkari kasari banaune?

aalu ra kauli tukra paarera dhunus. tel ma jeera ra methi halnus, ani aalu halera 5 minet bhutnus. kauli, besar, nun, khursani ra dhaniya jeera ko dhulo halera chhopnus ra sano aago ma pakaunus. pakepachhi golbheda ra hariyo dhaniya halera 2 minet chalaunus.
gundruk ko jhol kasari banaune?

gundruk lai 10 minet manta pani ma bhijayera nichornus. tel ma lasun, khursani ra pyaj bhutnus, ani gundruk halera 2-3 minet bhutnus. golbheda halnus, ani pani halera umalnus. nun milayera 10 minet pakaunus. bhatmas bhuteko halda jhan mitho hunchha.
masu ko jhol kasari mitho banaune?

masu lai nun, besar ra adhuwa lasun ko paste ma 30 minet rakhnus. tel ma pyaj rato hunjel bhutera masu halnus ra thulo aago ma ramrari bhutnus. golbheda ra masala halera pani halnus, ani chhopera sano aago ma masu naram nahunjel pakaunus. antya ma hariyo dhaniya ra alikati jwanu halda basna ramro hunchha.
kheer kasari pakaune?

aadha cup chamal dhoyera 30 minet bhijaunus. 1 litre dudh umalera chamal halnus ra sano aago ma bela bela chalaudai pakaunus, nalagos bhanera. chamal naram bhayepachhi chini, alaichi ra kaju kismis halnus. gadha bhayepachhi aago banda garnus, chiso bhaye pachhi jhan gadha hunchha.
bacheko bhat le fried rice kasari banaune?

raati ko chiso bhat nai fried rice ko lagi ramro hunchha. tel ma lasun, pyaj ra kaati rakheko tarkari thulo aago ma bhutnus. anda phodera alikati bhutnus, ani bhat halera nun, besar ki soy sauce sanga ramrari chalaunus. hariyo pyaj ki dhaniya mathi halera taato taato khanus.
dhido kasari banaune, gaanthi parchha

pani umalnu agadi nai alikati nun halnus. umleko pani ma pitho bistarai, thorai thorai halnus ra daadu ki pindo le lagatar chalaunus. gaanthi parna nadina ek haat le pitho halne ra arko le chalaune garnus. bakla bhayepachhi sano aago ma 5 minet chhopera pakaunus.
omelette naram kasari banaune?

2 wata anda ma alikati nun, pyaj, khursani ra 1 chamcha dudh ki pani milayera ramrari phenus. tawa ma tel madhyam taato garnus, dherai taato haina. anda halera chhopera sano aago ma pakaunus. mathi ko bhag jameko bela patlaunus ra 1 minet pachhi utarnus.
tarkari pasal ma taja tarkari kasari chinne?

saag ko paat hariyo ra naram hunu parchha, pahelo ra oilaeko haina. golbheda chamkilo ra ali kada, dherai naram haina. aalu ma hariyo daag ra tusa nabhayeko chhannus. kauli ko phool sapha ra kasilo hunu parchha. bihana bazaar jaanda taja tarkari paainchha.
masala chhito bigrinchha, kasari rakhne?

masala hawa nachhirne bhaado ma chiso ra andhyaro thau ma rakhnus, chulo najik haina. bhijeko chamcha le masala naniklaunus, chiso le dhusi lagchha. dherai matra ma ek palta nakinnus, 2-3 mahina ko matra kinnus. sabut masala pisera matra prayog garda basna lamo samaya rahanchha.
mustang bike ma jaane plan, k tayari?

bike ko servicing ramro sanga garaunus: brake, tyre, chain ra suspension. bato dherai thau ma kachchi ra dhunga bhayeko chha, bistarai chalaunus ra raati nachalaunus. chiso ra hawa ko lagi nyano jacket, panja ra mask boknus. barsha ma pahiro jaane bhayekale mausam ra bato ko khabar bujhera matra jaanus.
pokhara ma paragliding garda surakshit hunchha?

darta bhayeko ra anubhavi company bata garda dherai jaso surakshit hunchha. pilot ko license ra company ko naam bujhnus, sasto ko lobh ma nachhannus. mausam kharab bhaye company le nai udan rokchha, tyo niyam manusnus. sharirik samasya, jastai mutu ko rog bhaye pahila doctor sanga sodhnus.
rafting jaane, k dhyan dine?

darta bhayeko company ra anubhavi guide chhannus. life jacket ra helmet sadhai lagaunus ra pura samaya nakholnus. guide ko nirdeshan dhyan le sunnus, khas gari pani ma khaseko bela k garne. mulyawan saman ra phone pani nahine jhola ma rakhnus.
budhi aama buwa sanga yatra garda k dhyan dine?

yatra lamo bhaye bich bich ma aaram ko samaya rakhnus. unko niyamit aushadhi ra prescription ko copy sangai rakhnus. bharyang dherai nabhayeko hotel ra sajilo bato chhannus. chiso ra garmi anusar lugaa ra pani ko byabastha garnus, ani unko gati ma hidnus.
kam budget ma ghumne tarika?

chad ra bidaa ko bheed bahek ko samaya ma jaanus, hotel ra bus sasto hunchha. sarkari bus ki sajha yatayat ra homestay ma basnus. sthaniya khana khanus, pasal ko packet khaja bhanda sasto ra mitho. samuha ma jaanda gadi ra kotha ko kharcha baadna milchha.
hotel ma basda suraksha kasari?

kotha ma pasne bittikai dhoka ko lock ra jhyal jaanch garnus. mulyawan saman kotha ma chhodnu parda locker prayog garnus ki sangai rakhnus. kotha number ajnabi lai nabhannus. aago lagda bhaagne bato kaha chha ek palta hernus.
bus ko seat online book garda thagi hunchha?

ramro naam bhayeko ra chalan ma raheko app ki website bata matra book garnus. bhuktani pachhi ticket ko SMS ki email aayo ki jaanch garnus. facebook ma "sasto ticket" bhanne aparichit lai paisa napathaunus. shanka lage bus company ko counter ma phone garera booking pakka garnus.
nagarikta ko praman patra haraayo

pahila najik ko prahari karyalaya ma harayeko ujuri dinus, tyasko kagaj chahinchha. tyas pachhi jilla prashasan karyalaya ma pratilipi ko lagi nibedan dinus. nagarikta ko number ra photocopy chha bhane kaam sajilo hunchha. aagadi ko lagi mahatwapurna kagaj ko photo ra photocopy chhuttai surakshit rakhnus.
mero phone harayo, k garne?

arko phone bata afno number ma phone garnus, najik kahi chha ki thaha hunchha. "find my device" jasto suvidha bata phone kaha chha herna ra lock garna sakinchha. sim company lai phone garera sim block garnus, bank ra wallet ko password pani turuntai badalnus. chori bhayeko jasto lage prahari ma ujuri dinus.
ATM le card khayo, paisa pani aayena

aatinus, pahila ATM ma lekheko bank ko helpline ma phone garnus. card turuntai block garna lagaunus. paisa katyo tara aayena bhane bank ma ujuri dinus, dherai jaso kehi din ma firta aauchha. ATM ko naam, thau ra samaya lekhera rakhnus.
galti le arko ko account ma paisa pathaye

turuntai afno bank ma phone garnus ki shakha ma gayera bataunus, jati chhito utti ramro. transaction ko bibaran ra screenshot rakhnus. bank le arko account bhayeko bank sanga sampark garchha. paune manchhe chinne bhaye namra bhayera sidhai firta garna anurodh garnus.
nakkali note jasto lagchha, k garne?

note lai ujyalo tira herera watermark ra suraksha dhago chha ki hernus, chhuda kagaj farak lagchha ki pani. shanka lagyo bhane tyo note aru lai chalauna nakhojnus, tyo galat ho. najik ko bank ma dekhaunus. thulo note linda tyahi bela jaanch garne baani rakhnus.
bus ma jeb katyo, aba k garne?

pahila najik ko prahari ma ujuri dinus, bus ko number ra samaya bhannus. card ra wallet harayeko bhaye bank lai turuntai phone garera block garaunus. nagarikta ki license harayo bhane ujuri ko kagaj pachhi pratilipi banauna chahinchha. aagadi bheed ma jhola agadi rakhnus ra paisa bhitri jeb ma.
ghar ma pani ko abhav chha

pani bharne bela ma tanki ra bhaado bharera rakhnus. bhaada dhuda ra nuhauda dhara khulai narakhnus, baltin prayog garnus. chuheko dhara ra pipe chhito marmat garnus. chhana ko barsha ko pani jamma garne byabastha pani ramro upaya ho.
bijuli ko bill dherai aayo

kun saman le dherai bijuli khanchha hernus: heater, geyser, iron ra purano fridge. kotha bata nisknda batti ra fan banda garnus ra LED bulb prayog garnus. charger ra TV ko plug prayog nabhaye nikalnus. meter ko unit aafai lekhera bill sanga milayera hernus, galti bhaye bijuli karyalaya ma sodhnus.
ghar ko phohor kasari chhutyaune?

kuhine phohor, jastai tarkari ko bokra, ra nakuhine phohor, jastai plastic ra sisa, chhuttai bhaado ma rakhnus. kuhine phohor bata compost banauna sakinchha. plastic ra kagaj sapha garera kabadi lai dina milchha. batti ra aushadhi jasta khatarnak phohor chhuttai rakhnus.
chhat ma tarkari lagauna sakinchha?

sakinchha! gamla, purano baltin ki bora ma mato ra compost milayera saag, golbheda, khursani ra dhaniya lagauna sajilo hunchha. ghaam ramro aaune thau chhannus. bhaado ko tala pani nikalne pwal banaunus. chhat ma dherai gahrungo nahos bhanera thulo bhaado ko satta sano sano bhaado ramro.
tarkari ma kira lagyo

kira lageko paat haat le tipera hataunus ra bihana pani ko phohora le dhunus. neem ko paat umalera chiso bhayeko pani chharkine chalan pani chha. sabai bot ma phailinu agadi kira lageko bot chhuttyaunus. bish prayog garnu parne bhaye krishi praabidhik sanga sodhera matra matra milayera garnus.
gai le khana khadaina, birami jasto

gai lai chiso sapha pani ra halka ghans dinus, ra chhuttai shanta thau ma rakhnus. pet phuleko, jworo, pishab disa farak bhayeko ki dudh ghatyo bhane chhito pashu chikitsak ki pashu sewa karyalaya ma sampark garnus. afai mahango aushadhi nadinus.
kukhura ma rog lagyo, ek ek gari marchhan

birami kukhura turuntai arko khor ma chhuttyaunus, rog sarna sakchha. khor sapha garera chuna halnus ra pani ko bhaado din din dhunus. marekalai gaadnus ki jalaunus, khulla naphalnus. pashu sewa karyalaya ma chhito sampark garnus, khop ra upachar ko salah linus.
school ma kehi bidyarthi le malai hepchhan, hiraunchhan

yo tapai ko galti haina, ra kasaile pani tapai lai hepne adhikar chhaina. teacher, aama buwa ki bharosa ko thulo manchhe lai turuntai bhannus, chup lagera nasahanus. sakesamma sathi haru sangai rahanus, eklai hepne lai mauka kam hunchha. k, kahile ra kasle garyo lekhera rakhnus.
online ma kasai le naramro comment gari dhamki diyo

jawaf nadinus, jhagada badhchha. comment ra message ko screenshot rakhnus, ani tyo account lai block ra report garnus. bharosa ko thulo manchhe lai bhannus. dhamki gambhir bhaye cyber bureau ma ujuri garna sakinchha.
sathi haru le mero sharir ko barema gilla garchhan

sharir ko barema hepnu galat ho, tapai ko sharir tapai ko ho. ek palta spasta bhannus: "yasto kura le malai naramro lagchha, nagara." pheri pani gare tyo samuha bata ali tadha rahanus ra bharosa ko manchhe lai bhannus. afno ramro guna ra sip ma dhyan dinus.
ma bolda atkinchhu (hakla), lajja lagchha

dherai jana lai bolda atkine samasya hunchha, ra yo lajja ko kura haina. bistarai, saas line samaya dinus ra chhoto vakya ma bolnus. ghar ma thulo swar ma padhne abhyas garnus. sambhav bhaye speech therapist sanga salah linus, abhyas le dherai sudhar hunchha.
bihe ma naachna lajja lagchha

naach ma perfect hunu pardaina, sabai ramailo garna naachchhan! najik ko sathi sanga suru garnus, 1-2 sajilo step matra siknus. geet ko taal ma halka hallinu nai pugchha. ek palta suru gare pachhi lajja aafai harauchha.
dai ko bihe ma bhashan dinu parchha

2-3 minet ko chhoto bhashan pugchha. suru ma afno parichaya, ani dai ko barema euta ramailo ki mitho yaad, ra antya ma dulaha dulahi lai shubhakamana. kagaj ma mukhya bunda lekhera rakhnus. 2-3 palta ghar ma abhyas garnus ra bistarai bolnus.
kasaiko ghar ma mrityu bhayo, bhetna jaanda k bolne?

dherai bolnu pardaina, "dherai dukha lagyo, ma tapai sanga chhu" bhanne nai pugchha. unle bolna chahe dhyan le sunnus. "kina bhayo" jasto prashna nasodhnus. khana pakaidine, bachcha herne jasto sano kaam ma madat dina tayar rahanus.
sathi aspatal ma chha, herna jaanda k lane?

aspatal ko niyam ra bhetne samaya pahila bujhnus. sano upahar, jastai phal ki kitab, linu sakinchha, tara khana ko lagi doctor ko niyam sodhnus. dherai bera nabasnus, birami lai aaram chahinchha. chhoto, sakaratmak kura garnus ra rugha lageko bela najaanus.
pahilo palta date ma jaane, nervous

nervous hunu swabhabik ho, uni pani nervous hola. sapha ra aaram dayak lugaa lagaunus ra samaya mai pugnus. afai bolnu bhanda unko kura ma ruchi dekhaunus, prashna sodhnus. ramailo ra shanta thau chhannus, ra dabab naliunus, pahilo bhet ma sabai pakka hunu pardaina.
long distance relationship kasari chalaune?

niyamit kura garne samaya tokdinus, tara har ghanta message garnu parne dabab narakhnus. ek arka lai din ko sano kura pani bhannus, najik bhayeko mahsus hunchha. bhetne yojana banaunus, parkhai sajilo hunchha. bharosa ra imandari nai mukhya ho.
breakup bhayeko sathi lai kasari sahayog garne?

salah dinu bhanda pahila sunnus, "timi lai kasto lagirahechha?" bhanera sodhnus. purano manchhe lai gali garna nalagaunus, sathi ko man ali bhinna hunasakchha. bahira hidna, khana khana jasto sano kaam ma sangai lagnus. dherai hapta samma ekdam udas rahe bisheshagya sanga kura garna protsahan dinus.
chhora SEE ma fail bhayo, aama buwa le k garne?

pahila gali nagari chhora ko man bujhnus, uslai pani dukheko hunchha. "ek exam le timi lai napdaina, hami sangai chhau" bhannus. supplementary exam ko niyam bujhnus ra kun subject ma kamjor bhayo herera sahayog ko yojana banaunus. aru bachcha sanga tulana nagarnus.
kaam ma thulo galti bhayo, dar lagyo

galti lukauna khojda jhan thulo hunchha, tyasaile chhito manager lai bhannus. k bhayo, kina bhayo ra kasari sudharne bhanne kura sangai lyaunus. maafi magnus tara dherai afulai dosh nadinus. aagadi yasto nahos bhanera k parivartan garne bhanne pani bhannus, bharosa farkinchha.
naya kaam chhito kasari sikne?

pahilo hapta sabai kura ek copy ma lekhnus: process, naam ra sodhne manchhe. ekai kura pheri sodhnu nanoparos bhanera lekheko herdai garnus. ramro kaam garne sahakarmi kasari garchhan hernus. hapta ko ant ma manager sanga "mero kaam kasto chha?" bhanera feedback linus.
meeting kasari chalaune? pahilo palta

meeting agadi bishaya ra samaya sabai lai pathaunus, jastai 30 minet ma 3 wata kura. suru ma meeting ko lakshya bhannus ra samaya ko dhyan rakhnus. sabai lai bolne mauka dinus. antya ma ko le k garne ra kahile samma bhanne kura lekhera sabai lai pathaunus.
sano team ko manager bhaye, kasari ramro garne?

team ka har sadasya sanga eklai kura garnus ra unko kaam ra chunauti bujhnus. kaam spasta baadnus ra kahile samma bhanne pani bhannus. ramro kaam ko prashamsa sabai ko agadi, sudhar ko kura eklai ma garnus. afu pani samaya ra niyam palnus, team le herera sikchha.
chhora le mahango phone mageko chha

sidhai "hudaina" bhanda pahila kina chahiyo bujhnus. phone ko lagi paisa bachauna afai sahayog garne yojana, jastai pocket money ko kehi bhag, banauna sakinchha. ghar ko budget ko barema imandar kura garnus. mahango bhanda kaam lagne phone ra phone ko niyam dubai sangai tay garnus.
kirana saman ma kharcha ghataune tarika?

bajar jaanu agadi list banaunus ra list bahira ko kam kinnus. chahine saman thok ma ra mausami tarkari kinnus. bhok lageko bela kinmel najaanus, badhi kinchhinchha. ghar ma k chha pahila herera matra jaanus, dohoro kinne baani ghatchha.
sano pasal ko hisab kasari rakhne?

euta copy ma har din ko bikri ra kharcha chhuttai lekhnus, beluka jodnus. udhar ko lagi chhuttai copy rakhnus. pasal ko paisa ra ghar ko paisa namisaunus. mahina ko ant ma nafa noksan herera kun saman badhi bikchha thaha paunus.
chini khana chhodna chahanchhu

ek palta mai chhodnu garo hunchha, bistarai ghataunus: chiya ma chini aadha garnus. chiso peya ko satta pani ki nibuwa pani piunus. mithai khane man lagda phal khanus. packet ko khana ma lukeko chini hunchha, label padhne baani banaunus.
bachcha ko aankha kamjor bhayo jasto, TV najik basera herchha

bachcha TV najik basera herchha, aankha michkauchha ki taauko dukhchha bhanchha bhane aankha ko doctor dekhaunus. screen ko samaya ghataunus ra bahira khelne samaya badhaunus. padhda ujyalo ramro hos. chashma chahiyo bhane niyamit lagauna sikaunus.
padhda jhukera baschhu, ghaati dukhchha

kitab ali uchai ma rakhnus, table ma kitab ko stand ki thulo kitab muni rakhera. kursi ma pura dhaad lagayera basnus. har 30-40 minet ma ghaati bistarai ghumaunus ra kandh tannus. dukhai badhe ki haat samma jharyo bhane doctor dekhaunus.
bachcha ko kaan dukhchha re, raati runchha

kaan bhitra tel ki kunai chij nahalnus. bachcha lai ali uchai takiya ma sutaunus ra dukhai ko lagi doctor ki pharmacist sanga sodhera matra aushadhi dinus. jworo, kaan bata pip, sunna kam ki 1-2 din ma niko nabhaye bachcha ko doctor dekhaunus.
bachcha le bomit garyo, 3 palta

bachcha lai jeevan jal thorai thorai gari, ek ek chamcha, bela bela dinus. ek palta ma dherai napiyaunus, pheri bomit hunchha. bomit rokiepachhi halka khana dinus. ragat aayo, dherai sust bhayo, pisab kam bhayo, pet dherai dukhyo ki bomit rokiyena bhane turuntai doctor kaha jaanus.
garmi ma jiu ma rato bimiro (ghamaura) aayo
chiso pani le nuhaunus ra khukulo kapas ko lugaa lagaunus. pasina aaune thau sukha rakhnus. ghamaura nakanyaunus. chhaya ra hawa aaune thau ma basnus. ghau, pip ki jworo aaye doctor dekhaunus.
budhi aama lai raati nidra lagdaina

diuso lamo nidra kam garaunus ra din ma halka hidaai garaunus. beluka chiya coffee nadinus. sutne bela niyamit rakhnus ra kotha shanta ra andhyaro banaunus. kunai aushadhi ko karan le pani nidra bigrina sakchha, tyasaile doctor sanga sodhnus.
dam (asthma) chha, jado ma badhchha

doctor le diyeko inhaler sadhai sangai rakhnus ra kasari prayog garne sahi tarika siknus. dhuwa, dhulo ra chiso hawa bata bachnus, bahira jaanda mask lagaunus. jado ma nyano lugaa lagaunus. saas phernai garo bhayo, inhaler le kaam garena bhane turuntai aspatal jaanus.
dhulo le sadhai chhyau aauchha, allergy jasto

ghar sapha garda bhijeko kapada le puchhnus, jharu le dhulo udchha. bistara ko tanna ra takiya ko kabhar hapta ma ek palta taato pani le dhunus. bahira dhulo dherai bhayeko thau ma mask lagaunus. lakshan dherai bhaye ki saas pherna garo bhaye doctor sanga salah linus.
shahar ma bato haraye

aatinus ra bheed bhayeko surakshit thau ma rokinus. phone ma map hernus, ki najik ko pasal ki prahari lai sodhnus. ghar ko thegana ra najik ko chineko thau ko naam bhannus. raati bhaye ajnabi ko gadi ma nachadhnus, chineko lai phone garnus.
taxi wala le dherai bhada magchha

chadhnu agadi nai bhada pakka garnus ki meter chalaune bhannus. 2-3 taxi sanga sodhda uchit mol thaha hunchha. ride app prayog garda bhada pahila nai dekhinchha. jhagada nagarnus, milena bhane arko taxi linus.
trek ma bima chahinchha?

uchai ma trek garne lai swasthya ra uddhar (rescue) samettine bima ramro hunchha, helicopter le uddhar garnu parda kharcha dherai hunchha. bima linu agadi kun uchai samma ra k k samettinchha padhnus. bima ko kagaj ra phone number trek ma sangai rakhnus.
hiundo ma trek jaane, k farak tayari?

hiundo ma mathi hiu ra ekdam chiso hunchha, kehi bato ra lodge banda pani hunchhan, pahila bujhnus. ramro slipping bag, nyano jacket, panja, topi ra hiu ma chalne jutta chahinchha. din chhoto hunchha, bihana chhito suru garera ujyalo mai pugnus. mausam kharab bhaye bato nachhodnus, rokinu nai surakshit.
gaun ma ATM chhaina, kati paisa boknu?

yatra ko pura kharcha ra 20-30% thap aakasmik paisa nagad boknus. paisa ek thau ma narakhnus, jhola ra jiu ma baadera rakhnus. sano note dherai rakhnus, gaun ma thulo note satna garo hunchha. digital wallet chalne thau bhaye pani internet nahuna sakchha.
kanchhi chhori lai dherai ris uthchha, bhuin ma ladchhe

sano bachcha ma ris pokhine yo baani samanya ho. tyo bela shanta rahanus ra uslai surakshit rakhnus, chichyaera karaunu le jhan badhchha. shanta bhayepachhi "timi lai ris uthyo, hoina?" bhanera bhawana ko naam sikaunus. ris le dherai chot laune ki bar bar badhdai gaye bachcha ko doctor sanga salah linus.
padhaune class ma bidyarthi le dhyan dinna, teacher hu ma

10-15 minet ma padhaune tarika badalnus: bhanne, sodhne, sano group kaam. suru ma euta prashna ki sano katha le ruchi jagaunus. bidyarthi ko naam linus ra sabai lai sahabhagi garaunus. ramro prayas ko prashamsa garnus, gali bhanda prashamsa le dherai kaam garchha.
ghar ma pariwar ko photo haru kasari surakshit rakhne?

purana photo phone le scan garera digital copy banaunus ra cloud ra pen drive dubai ma rakhnus. photo album sukha thau ma, ghaam ra chiso bata tadha rakhnus. photo ko pachhadi naam ra saal lekhnus, pachhi ko pustalai kaam lagchha.
hamro tole ma phohor dherai, k garna sakinchha?

chhimeki sanga milera tole sudhar samiti ki samuha banaunus. mahina ma ek din sarsafai abhiyan garnus ra phohor phalne thau tokdinus. sthaniya palika ko phohor gadi kahile aauchha bujhnus. sano suru le pani dherai manchhe lai prerit garchha.
plastic ko prayog kasari ghataune?
bazaar jaanda kapada ko jhola sangai boknus. pani ko bottle aafnai bharera boknus. pasal ma plastic ko jhola napani bhannus. ghar ma bhayeka plastic ko bhaado pheri prayog garnus, chhito naphalnus.
haluwa kasari banaune?

ghiu taato garera suji ramro basna aaunjel bistarai bhutnus, dalaunu hunna. arkai bhaado ma pani ki dudh ra chini umalnus. bhuteko suji ma bistarai halera lagatar chalaunus, gaanthi naparos. alaichi, kaju ra kismis halera bakla bhayepachhi utarnus.
chhoila kasari banaune?

masu lai nun ra besar laayera sekera ki polera pakaunus, ani sano tukra paarnus. tyasma adhuwa, lasun, khursani ko dhulo, nun ra kagati milaunus. tori ko tel taato gari methi ra besar jhaanera halnus. hariyo pyaj ra dhaniya halera chiura sanga khanus.
masu kinda taja ho ki kasari chinne?

taja masu ko rang chamkilo hunchha, dherai kalo ki hariyo haina. gandha naramro ki amilo aaye nakinnus. thichda masu pheri farkinchha bhane taja ho. sapha pasal ra fridge bhayeko thau bata kinnus ra ghar lyaera chhito pakaunus ki fridge ma rakhnus.
fridge ma kun kura kaha rakhne?

pakaeko khana ra dahi mathi ko tah ma, kaancho masu tala ko tah ma chhopera rakhnus, ragat aru khana ma nachuhos. tarkari tala ko drawer ma rakhnus. fridge lai dherai thuplo nabharnus, chiso hawa ghumna paunu parchha. hapta ma ek palta purano khana hataunus.
pressure cooker ko rubber chhito bigrinchha

prayog pachhi rubber nikalera sapha garnus ra sukaera rakhnus. ati taato aago ma lamo samaya narakhnus. rubber chiplo ki phuteko bhaye turuntai fernus, pressure bahira jaanchha. naya rubber sahi size ko kinnus, cooker ko company ra litre bhannus.
mero shrimati ra aama bich bhanchha ma jhagada

dubai lai maya garne tapai bichma parnu garo hunchha. dubai sanga chhuttai shanta bela ma kura garnus ra dubai ko kura sunnus. bhanchha ko kaam ra niyam, jastai ko le kahile pakaune, sabai sanga milayera tay garnus. ek pakshya lai matra dosh nadinus.
chhori 16 barsha ki bhain, phone ma ajnabi sanga kura garchhe jasto

gali ra dhamki bhanda shanta bhayera online suraksha ko kura garnus: ajnabi sanga photo ra thegana nadine, bhetna najaane. "kehi asajilo bhaye ma sanga bhana, ma risaudina" bhanera bharosa dinus. phone ko niyam sangai banaunus. dhamki ki shoshan ko shanka bhaye cyber bureau ma ujuri garna sakinchha.
ghar ma sabai le malai "alchhi" bhanchhan

yo sunda naramro lagchha. sano kaam ko jimmewari afai linus, jastai har din bhaada majhne ki bihana chiya banaune, ra niyamit garnus. sano kaam lagatar gare bhawana badlinchha. ghar ka manchhe sanga kun kaam ma tapai ko madat chahinchha bhanera sodhnus.
sathi sanga trek jaane, tara usko gati chhito

suru mai dubai ko gati ra aaram ko samaya ko barema kura garnus. chhito hidne lai agadi gayera tokeko thau ma parkhine niyam banaunus. tara uchai ma ra jungle ma kahile pani dherai tadha chhuttinu hudaina. thakai lagda imandar bhayera bhannus, jabarjasti hidda chot lagchha.
dherai garmi ma bachcha lai kasari bachaune?

bachcha lai halka kapas ko lugaa lagaunus ra dupahar ko ghaam bata bachaunus. pani, jhol ra phal ko ras bela bela dinus, pyas lagna agadi nai. bachcha lai band gadi ma kahile pani eklai nachhodnus. ekdam sust, uchho jworo ki pisab kam bhaye turuntai doctor kaha jaanus.
tihar ma patakha padkauda k sawdhani?

khulla thau ma ra ghar, gadi ra sukheko ghans bata tadha padkaunus. bachcha lai thulo manchhe ko najik rakhera matra padkauna dinus. padkena bhane najik gayera najaanus, ek baltin pani tayar rakhnus. jaleko bhaye 15-20 minet chiso bagdo pani ma rakhnus ra dherai jaleko bhaye aspatal jaanus.
dashain ma dherai masu khayera pet kharab hunchha

ek palta ma dherai nakhanus, thorai thorai khanus ra sangai tarkari ra salad pani khanus. masu ramrari pakeko hos ra dherai din rakheko masu nakhanus. pani dherai piunus ra khana pachhi ali hidnus. pet dherai dukhyo, lagatar disa ki bomit bhaye jeevan jal piunus ra doctor dekhaunus.
ping khelda chot lagla bhanne dar

ping ko dori ra kath ko baliyo pan pahila jaanch garnus. ek palta ma ek jana matra chadhnus ra dherai mathi pugna jabarjasti nagarnus. sano bachcha lai thulo ko herchah ma matra khelna dinus. ping ko agadi pachhadi manchhe ubhinu hudaina.
changa udauda k dhyan dine?

chhat ma changa udauda chheu ma barenda nabhaye dherai khatara hunchha, surakshit chhat ki khulla chaur ma udaunus. bijuli ko taar najik kahile pani naudaunus. sisa haleko dhago le haat katna sakchha, panja lagaunus. bachcha lai chhat ma eklai nachhodnus.
padhda music sunnu ramro ki naramro?

shabda bhayeko gaana le dhyan baadchha, khas gari padhne ra lekhne kaam ma. sunnai chha bhane bina shabda ko shanta sangeet sano awaj ma sunnus. garo chapter padhda ki yaad garda shanta vatavaran nai ramro. sajilo kaam, jastai chitra banauda, sangeet le samasya gardaina.
dherai subject chha, kun pahila padhne?

dimag taja hune bela, jastai bihana, sabai bhanda garo subject padhnus. thakeko bela sajilo ki man parne subject rakhnus. ek din ma 2-3 subject matra ghumaunus, sabai ek din ma nathupnus. exam najik ko subject lai thap samaya dinus.
mobile app bata padhne ki kitab bata?

kitab le dhyan ramro rakhchha, phone ma notification le dhyan bhaangchha. app chai video ra quiz ko lagi ramro hunasakchha. padhda phone prayog garnu parne bhaye airplane mode ma rakhnus. mukhya padhai kitab ra copy ma, abhyas ko lagi app, yasto milayera garnus.
kaksha 12 pachhi 1 barsha gap linu thik ho?

yojana bhaye gap year ramro hunasakchha: entrance tayari, kaam ko anubhav ki computer, bhasa jasta sip sikne. tara yojana bina ko gap ma samaya barbad hunchha. gap lida k sikne ra kahile samma bhanne lekhit lakshya banaunus. ghar ka manchhe sanga pani pahila kura garnus.
8 barsha ko chhora ko padhai ko routine kasto banaune?

school pachhi pahila khaja ra 30-45 minet khelne samaya dinus. ani 45 minet-1 ghanta padhai, bich ma sano aaram sahit. sutnu agadi katha ko kitab padhne baani basaunus. ekai samaya ma padhne niyam le bachcha lai sajilo hunchha, lamo samaya jabarjasti nabasaunus.
dimag tez banaune khana k ho?

kunai jaadu ko khana chhaina, tara santulit khana le dimag lai ramro rakhchha: dal, anda, dudh, hariyo saag, phal ra gedagudi. bihana ko khaja nachhodnus ra pani pugdo piunus. sabai bhanda thulo kura ramro nidra ra niyamit abhyas ho. "yo khaye topper bhaincha" bhanne vigyapan ma bharosa nagarnus.
math ko word problem bujhdina

prashna 2 palta bistarai padhnus ra diyeko sankhya ma rekha tannus. "k sodheko chha" bhanne kura chhuttai lekhnus. sakchhu bhane sano chitra banaunus. ani sano step ma hisab garnus ra antim ma uttar prashna sanga milchha ki jaanch garnus.
science ko diagram ramro banauna sakdina

diagram ko mukhya akar matra pahila halka pencil le banaunus, sabai detail ek palta nahalnus. label sidha line le bahira tannus ra sapha akshar ma lekhnus. kitab ko diagram herera 3-4 palta abhyas garnus. exam ma sundar bhanda sahi ra sapha label badhi mahatwapurna hunchha.
BBS ko account ma ledger garo lagyo

pahila debit ra credit ko niyam ramro sanga bujhnus, ratnu bhanda udaharan bata. har din 2-3 wata sano journal ra ledger ko prashna afai garnus. galti bhayeko thau chhuttai lekhnus. account ma abhyas nai sabai bhanda thulo sutra ho, padhera matra hudaina.
computer engineering padhna math ma kati ramro hunu parchha?

math ko aadhar, jastai algebra ra calculus ko suruwat, ramro bhaye sajilo hunchha. tara suru ma kamjor bhaye pani niyamit abhyas le sudhrinchha. entrance ko syllabus herera math ko kun bhag chahinchha thaha paunus. programming ma logical sochaai pani mahatwapurna ho, tyo abhyas le aauchha.
naya bhasha japanese sikna chahanchhu

pahila hiragana ra katakana akshar sikna, 2-3 hapta ma sakinchha. din ma 30 minet niyamit padhnus ra sajilo vakya bolne abhyas garnus. flash card ra bhasa sikne app kaam lagchha. sakchhu bhane kunai class ma judnus, bolne sathi paunchhau.
dherai padhchhu tara number aaudaina

padhne tarika herna parchha: padhera matra ki afai lekhera abhyas? purano question paper samaya rakhera solve garnus ra kun prashna ma ank gumyo hernus. teacher lai tapai ko uttar ek palta jaanch garna dinus. dherai samaya bhanda sahi tarika le padhda ramro number aauchha.
SEE pachhi 3 mahina chhutti, k garne?

computer ko aadhar, typing ra english bolne abhyas jasta sip sikna ramro samaya ho. man parne kitab padhnus ra ghar ko kaam ma madat garnus. +2 ma padhne bishaya ko suruwat ko chapter halka herda pachhi sajilo hunchha. ali aaram ra ramailo pani garnus, yo samaya pheri aaudaina.
raati padhda aankha dukhchha

kotha ma ujyalo pura rakhnus ra table lamp ko ujyalo kitab ma sidhai parne gari rakhnus. kitab aankha bata 30-40 cm tadha rakhnus. har 30 minet ma tadha ko kura hernus ra aankha jhimkaunus. dukhai lagatar rahyo ki dhamilo dekhinchha bhane aankha jaanch garaunus.
hiundo ma nuhauna alchhi lagchha

diuso ghaam lageko nyano bela nuhaunus, kotha ma hawa nachhirne gari. sabai din pura nuhauna nasake pani manta pani le haat, khutta, kaakhi ra anuhar dhunus. pani tataera rakhne ra nuhayepachhi turuntai nyano lugaa lagaune garnus. sarsafai le rog bata bachauchha.
gaun ma aspatal tadha chha, sano chot lagda k garne?

sano ghau lai sapha pani le dhoyera sapha kapada ki patti le chhopnus. ragat bagda 10 minet thichera rakhnus. ghar ma sano first aid box rakhnus. tara gahiro ghau, haddi bhanchiyo jasto, taauko ma chot, behos ki dherai ragat bhaye jati tadha bhaye pani turuntai swasthya sanstha lanus.
hajurba bisrane hunu bhayo, k garne?

budhyauli ma alikati bisrinu samanya ho, tara dherai badhdai gaye doctor sanga jaanch garaunus. dainik kaam ko sajilo routine banaunus ra aushadhi ko taalika lekhera rakhnus. unlai purano katha, kitab ra kura garne samaya dinus, dimag sakriya rahanchha. eklai bahira jaanda harauna sakchhan, ghar ko thegana bhayeko card khalti ma rakhnus.
jado ma sano bachcha lai kasari nyano rakhne?

ek mota lugaa bhanda 2-3 patla tah ramro hunchha. taauko, haat ra khutta chhopnus, nyano yahi bata janchha. kotha ma aago ki heater bhaye hawa aaune banaunus ra bachcha bata tadha rakhnus. bachcha ko ghaati ma chhuera hernus, dherai pasina aaye lugaa ghataunus.
bachcha ko daat aaundai chha, raati runchha

daat aaune bela gija dukhchha, yo samanya ho. sapha chiso daat lagaune khelauna ki sapha chiso kapada chapauna dinus. sapha aunla le gija bistarai malish garnus. jworo dherai aayo, disa lagyo ki khana chhodyo bhane doctor dekhaunus, daat le matra yasto hudaina.
bachcha ko diaper lagaune thau ma rato dabba

diaper chhito chhito fernus ra chhala lai sukha rakhnus. sapha manta pani le dhoyera puchhnus, ragadnus nai haina. kehi samaya diaper bina hawa lagne gari rakhnus. pharmacist sanga sodhera rash ko cream lagaunus, 3-4 din ma niko nabhaye ki ghau bhaye doctor dekhaunus.
dudh khuwaune aama le k khane?
